method: Built-in image generation using existing title skeleton identity; directional24-pose atlas. Original title asset unchanged.
layout: Walk down/right/up, attack down/right/up. Left mirrors right. Runtime per-pose AtlasTexture regions preserve all weapons and register feet.
visual_constraints: Bare ivory skull, dark sockets, tan bones, leather shoulder armor/bracers/boots, blue torn waistcloth, sword; no helmet/shield.
generation_prompt: Adapt canonical title skeleton into painted top-down three-quarter RPG four-column six-row walking/attack poses on transparent alpha; preserve identity/costume, actual back view, alternating steps and sword poses. Layout refinement adds empty gutters; per-pose runtime regions prevent grid clipping.
limitations: Three-quarter painted sprite, not a 3D model. Front/right windup frame1 is not used because hand continuity was weaker; actual attacks use strike/recovery poses.
